summary: Injured climber in Maroon Bells area suffered right ankle injury, able to communicate with 911 by cell phone; rescuers made contact ~8:50 PM, MRA medical personnel stabilized the ankle and the subject walked with assistance down the trail; two uninjured party members escorted out with camping gear; all teams at trailhead ~11:32 PM; 16 MRA members, 6-hour mission.
